L105: 【37†Show! Music Core】 Chart winners (2026)
L106: ---
L107: The Show! Music Core Chart is a 【38†record chart】 on the South Korean 【39†MBC】 television music program 【37†Show! Music Core】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【40†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast. Since March 1, 2025, the show has been hosted by 【41†Hearts2Hearts】' A-na, 【42†TWS】' Dohoon, and 【43†And2ble】's Kim Gyu-vin.^{【44†[1]】} A-na left in May 2, 2026.^{【45†[2]】}
